description: This file contains the implementation of ArrayStreamBufferWriter, a struct that implements IBufferWriter<byte> to write data to a Stream using an internal byte array buffer, with methods for advancing, getting memory/spans, and resizing the buffer.

classes.name: ArrayStreamBufferWriter
classes.description: A struct implementing IBufferWriter<byte> that writes to a Stream with an internal buffer, supporting buffer management and writing operations.

methods.name: ArrayStreamBufferWriter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the buffer with a specified size hint and associating it with a Stream.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the current position by a specified count, writing the buffer to the stream and resetting the index.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> representing the available buffer space, resizing if necessary.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> representing the available buffer space, resizing if necessary.

methods.name: CheckAndResizeBuffer
methods.description: Checks if the buffer needs resizing based on the size hint and resizes it accordingly.

methods.name: ThrowNegativeSizeHint
methods.description: Throws an ArgumentException if size hint is negative.

methods.name: ThrowNegativeAdvanceCount
methods.description: Throws an ArgumentException if advance count is negative.

methods.name: ThrowAdvancePastCapacity
methods.description: Throws an InvalidOperationException if an attempt is made to advance past the buffer capacity.
